question: What consequence follows from placing the lord-of-gods in a pot above the previously specified locations?
premises: The preceding context specifies locations for certain ritual placements.
A position above those locations is considered here.
The lord-of-gods may be situated in a pot at that higher position.
inference: If the lord-of-gods is situated in a pot above that level, he becomes the cause of all faults.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tad in tadūrdhvaṃ depends on the preceding verses' spatial scheme.
plain_english: If, above that, the lord of the gods is placed in a pot, he causes all faults.
